issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale with a TODO instead of executing the Union/Optional migration the PR advertises.
issues.detail: The PR description promises 'A | B' / 'A | None' modernization, but ruff.toml globally ignores the three rules that enforce it with a bare TODO. This leaves the codebase in two dialects with no tracking issue, no scope, and no kill date. Either land the auto-fix as a follow-up patch in the series or scope the ignore to specific paths.

issues.description: default_raise() sentinel and its '< 3.10 compatibility' rationale remain after the version branch was removed.
issues.detail: default_raise() and the comment above TransactionEndpointRequest still cite < 3.10 compatibility, but kw_only=True now expresses required-ness natively. The shim weakens the contract (RuntimeError at construct time vs TypeError at the call site) and misleads future maintainers. Remove the sentinel and use real required kw_only fields, or update the rationale.

issues.description: Diagnostic 'dnf search python3.12' (and unmotivated 'dnf update -y') left in the Amazon/Rocky CI prep steps.
issues.detail: The new prep runs dnf update plus dnf search before installing python3.12. Search is debug noise with no assertion on output, update -y heavily changes the test substrate every run, and neither affects install success. Drop the search and justify or remove the blanket update so the step's contract is deterministic.

issues.description: install.sh version guard still permits Python 3.7-3.9 while the error message claims '>= 3.10'.
issues.detail: The predicate reads PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7 but the printed error states '>= 3.10 and < 3.13.0'. A bare python3 resolving to 3.8 passes the numeric check yet contradicts the message. Tighten the lower bound to 10 so the predicate, the message, and pyproject all agree on a single minimum version.

issues.description: conditions.py 'continue' branch lost its explanatory comment without a replacement justification.
issues.detail: The previous multi-line comment explained a 3.9 coverage quirk and linked coveragepy#1530. The new code is bare 'continue' in an if/elif chain. Either the branch is now reachable and covered (delete the pragma), structurally unreachable (delete the branch), or kept as a defensive default (add a one-line invariant comment). Don't leave unreasoned control flow.

synthesis.summary: The mechanical removal of Python 3.9 support is correctly shaped where it actually deletes version forks (cmd_classes.py is a clean template), and the kw_only consolidation genuinely simplifies the dataclass surface. But the patch is half-done: the stated Union/Optional modernization is gated off in ruff.toml as a blanket TODO, the default_raise sentinel and its '< 3.10' comments survive as dead scaffolding in wallet_request_types.py, install.sh's guard still accepts 3.7-3.9 despite the error message claiming >=3.10, and a debug 'dnf search' (plus unmotivated 'dnf update -y') snuck into CI. Finish the ruff conversion (or scope the ignore), strip the stale compatibility shims, align the install.sh predicate with its message, and restore intent to the orphaned conditions.py branch before this lands.
